titles.native: まじかる★タルるートくん (1991)

description:
Fifth grader Edojou Honmaru is one of the most trodden upon losers in his class, untuil he meets Magical Taruruuto-kun. Taruruuto's powers help him deal with all his hardships, such as girls, bullies, and numerous other challenges.

(Source: Anime News Network)
